findings.title: Possible nil dereference of m.essentials
findings.message: The Share callback derefs m.essentials, which is only set in view() on construction; also the goroutine reads and writes m.shareTicket/m.status from the closure on a worker only inside Publish, which is fine, but `err` is captured and shared... In particular w.Context() is read on the worker, and `m.essentials` could be nil if the view was never built, causing a panic.

findings.title: Blocking os.Stat ignores context cancellation
findings.message: File sizes are not counted toward the 64 KiB total, only the path length, and Stat is done before native dispatch: TOCTOU is acknowledged. Also a symlink to a directory is followed by os.Stat; Lstat is not used, fine, but file items are stat'ed on the calling goroutine with no context cancellation, so a hung network filesystem blocks beyond ctx cancellation.
findings.suggestion: Run os.Stat in a goroutine selected against scope.Done(), or document the limitation.

findings.title: Shutdown path may race with deferred finish of committed share
findings.message: vellumCancelAllShares is called from shutdown on the main thread, but finish: is invoked with a selected-service session in flight; after finish, cleanup sets vellumShareSession=nil only when it matches. If a committed session is already cleaned, fine, but when selected, the dispatch_async finish may run after shutdown, calling vellumServiceResult against a torn-down service. The return value also reports failure (2) whenever the session survives.
findings.suggestion: Make shutdown idempotent: mark finished synchronously and ensure the later dispatched finish: is a no-op and does not call into torn-down service state.
